mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT pc.cluster_id FROM project_cluster pc JOIN project_member pm ON pm.project_id = pc.project_id JOIN project p ON p.id = pc.project_id AND p.deleted = false WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT count(*) FROM executor_node WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND deleted = false
SELECT count(*) FROM queue WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND deleted = false
SELECT count(*) FROM task WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING', 'STOPPING') AND deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE cluster SET deleted = true, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
